Name: (AT) Dogs in Doghouses
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Unfortunately our dogs can't actually go into the new doghouses, but I wanted to make it look like someone is using the doghouse!

Available for both doghouse colors, all 5 vanilla dog breeds, and 2 color palettes: vanilla and a recolor (slightly desaturated & less yellow).

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] -- visit Robin's shop to buy the "Paint Bucket" tool. With the tool selected, click on the Doghouse or Dark Doghouse (near the bottom) to see all available textures.

Marnie sells doghouses for 10,000g each (!) but if you use my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22388]Better Furniture Catalogue[/url], you can get them from the Furniture Catalogue.

Thanks to [b]herbivoor[/b] and [b]seitanicbean[/b] for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url]! I used its assets for the recolored dogs & doghouses.

Check out the companion mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23003](AT) Cats on Cat Trees (Animated)[/url]


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
